ModMetaData.name: Simple Farming
ModMetaData.author: Riketta
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a "farming" block to every animal's info card with husbandry math computed straight from the animal's own data, so vanilla, DLC and modded animals are all covered:
- Optimal male:female breeding ratio (for egg layers: whether males are needed at all, and the ratio for fertile eggs). - Average time until pregnancy / fertilization, and how it stretches the reproduction cycle. - Offspring and meat per female per day, and herd food upkeep including the male share. - Food spent to grow one adult (mother's gestation food + conception wait + growth food per life stage) and slaughter nutrition efficiency for every life stage, with the best age to slaughter. - Whether pregnant females are worth keeping until birth.
Everything is derived from game data (mate MTB, gestation, egg comps, life-stage hunger and body-size factors, meat stats) - nothing is hardcoded per animal. Optional debug logging and a dev-mode dump of all animals' stats.
Source code & details: https://github.com/Riketta/SimpleFarming
